description: List, build, or synchronize IRIS DeepSee cubes. 'list' returns all cubes with name, source class, fact count, and both `lastBuildTime` (ISO 8601 UTC) and `lastBuildTimeRaw` ($HOROLOG string) fields. 'build' triggers a full synchronous rebuild of a cube. 'sync' triggers an incremental synchronization of a cube.

server.description: Named server profile to target for this call (from `IRIS_PROFILES`). Omit to use the default server.

name: iris_analytics_cubes
title: Manage DeepSee Cubes
